attribute_fields.COMMENTS: Oklahoma state income tax calculation. Implements progressive tax structure per OK tax code (2025).

initial_action.action_postfix: "Oklahoma Tax Calculation Started" job.audit_trail swap addto

action_details.action_comment: Calculate Oklahoma tax - Single filer (progressive brackets)
action_details.action_postfix:
result.agi result.ok_standard_deduction_single sub 0 max /ok_taxable_income xdef
0 /ok_tax xdef
ok_taxable_income result.ok_bracket_1_limit min result.ok_bracket_1_rate mul ok_tax add /ok_tax xdef
ok_taxable_income result.ok_bracket_1_limit gt { ok_taxable_income result.ok_bracket_2_limit min result.ok_bracket_1_limit sub 0 max result.ok_bracket_2_rate mul ok_tax add /ok_tax xdef } if
ok_taxable_income result.ok_bracket_2_limit gt { ok_taxable_income result.ok_bracket_3_limit min result.ok_bracket_2_limit sub 0 max result.ok_bracket_3_rate mul ok_tax add /ok_tax xdef } if
ok_taxable_income result.ok_bracket_3_limit gt { ok_taxable_income result.ok_bracket_4_limit min result.ok_bracket_3_limit sub 0 max result.ok_bracket_4_rate mul ok_tax add /ok_tax xdef } if
ok_taxable_income result.ok_bracket_4_limit gt { ok_taxable_income result.ok_bracket_5_limit min result.ok_bracket_4_limit sub 0 max result.ok_bracket_5_rate mul ok_tax add /ok_tax xdef } if
ok_taxable_income result.ok_bracket_5_limit gt { ok_taxable_income result.ok_bracket_5_limit sub result.ok_bracket_6_rate mul ok_tax add /ok_tax xdef } if
ok_tax /result.state_tax_liability xdef
"Oklahoma tax (Single) calculated: $" result.state_tax_liability cvs strconcat job.audit_trail swap addto
